entry.name: rnbo_in
entry.description: Indexed event inlet to RNBO. Creates corresponding inlets on the rnbo~ object that will pass a bang, number, or list into the RNBO patch. In the exported code, creates a message tag like the inport object where the tag takes the form in1 , where in refers to the inlet and is the index of that inlet.
